zh.prompt: 一项追踪十万人的研究发现：每周运动 150 分钟的人，心血管疾病发病率比不运动者低 31%。据此，关于「运动与健康」能得出多强的结论？请在校准尺上标出合理强度。
hints: 证据支持「适量运动有益」，不是「包治百病」
也别滑向另一极——大样本数据确实支持运动有价值
结论的强度必须与证据的强度匹配
zh.explanation: 证据支持「适量运动显著改善心血管健康」，但推不到「包治百病」，也推不到「毫无作用」。结论的强度须与证据匹配：这里证据较强（大样本、明确相关），所以合理结论偏强一档，但仍须停在「心血管」这一具体收益内。会提问的人，知道该给结论配多大的力气。

en.prompt: A study tracking 100,000 people found that those who exercise 150 minutes a week had a 31% lower rate of cardiovascular disease than non-exercisers. Based on this, how strong a conclusion about 'exercise and health' is reasonable? Mark the reasonable strength on the scale.
hints: Evidence supports 'moderate exercise helps', not 'cures all'
Don't slide to the other extreme either — large-sample data does support exercise
The strength of a conclusion must match the strength of the evidence
en.explanation: The evidence supports 'moderate exercise significantly improves cardiovascular health', but not 'cures all' nor 'useless'. The strength of a conclusion must match the evidence: here the evidence is strong (large sample, clear correlation), so the reasonable conclusion leans a notch stronger — yet it must stay within the specific benefit of 'cardiovascular health'. A good questioner knows how much weight a conclusion can carry.
